snippet.title: TYPHON BvB Game [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
TYPHON: The first sci-fi indie game where Python skills are your weapons 🚀 Code. Survive. Rewrite the Future.

Trapped in a crumbling AI-run system, you won’t shoot your way out—you’ll code your way through. Every puzzle, every encounter, every escape depends on your ability to write and tweak real Python scripts.

🧠 Learn-by-doing gameplay
🤖 Adaptive Unity AI that responds to your code
📜 A rich, branching sci-fi narrative
💻 Built by ASSIST Software

👉 Follow us for more updates.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362580/Typhon_Bot_vs_Bot/
https://www.gog.com/en/game/typhon_bot_vs_bot
